name: Nextcloud
description: Nextcloud is an open-source self-hosted productivity platform for file sync, sharing, and collaboration. Built by Nextcloud GmbH in Stuttgart, it combines cloud storage with integrated apps for calendar, contacts, mail, video calls, and office documents a privacy-first alternative to proprietary cloud services.

owner.name: Nextcloud GmbH
owner.description: German company developing and supporting the Nextcloud open-source collaboration platform.
